# Research slice

## Objective
What single useful research outcome should this slice produce?

## Research question
State the question precisely. Use PICO/PECO or another structured frame when appropriate.

## Intended use / audience
Who will use this work, and is it for internal learning, professional posting, publication, education, or another purpose?

Do not cite or characterize a source as reviewed until it has actually been inspected.

## Clinical / evidence risks
- PHI or privacy risk:

## Planned artifacts
- [ ] Question/scope file
- [ ] Source log
- [ ] Evidence extraction
- [ ] Synthesis or draft, if in scope
- [ ] Fact/citation verification, if in scope

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One primary objective remains in scope
- [ ] No PHI or patient-identifiable information is committed
- [ ] Evidence-dependent claims trace to inspected sources
- [ ] Important numbers and citations are verified before final use
- [ ] Evidence strength and uncertainty are represented accurately
- [ ] Work is performed on a short-lived branch and reviewed through a PR

## Verification notes
Describe how completeness, citation accuracy, clinical wording, and truncation risk will be checked.
